civilopediaText.text: The Third Front Project was built in prepareation of the nuclear war. And history has proved our estimation being correct. It is the prove of the self-destructive tendency of capitalism. In retrospective. We were suppose prepare even more. - Li De Sheng

...but as far as the relation between the main forces and the guerrilla units is concerned, the former are on the interior lines while the latter are on the exterior lines, presenting a remarkable spectacle of pincers around the enemy. The same can be said of the relationship between the various guerrilla areas. From its own viewpoint each guerrilla area is on interior lines and the other areas are on exterior lines; together they form many battle fronts, which hold the enemy in pincers. - On Protracted War(1938)
